svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Cost per passing solution vs median latency (main ladder p01-p12, x log)
Purple ring: best trade-offs, pass rate ≥ 90%, then cost and time. Solid: normal speed; hollow: fast mode. * Codex cost is proxy.
Grok: black hexagons, all 12 problems, outside the best-trade-off line. grok47-medium (p01–p06 only) is not plotted.
